join hortbot 2 foobar 1


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add spam (_PARAMETER_) (_PARAMETER_) (_PARAMETER_) (_PARAMETER_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!spam the best
send hortbot #foobar [HB] the best the best the best the best

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!spam the best ; the worst
send hortbot #foobar [HB] the best the worst

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add spam (_PARAMETER_CAPS_) (_PARAMETER_CAPS_) (_PARAMETER_CAPS_) (_PARAMETER_CAPS_)
send_any

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!spam the best
send hortbot #foobar [HB] THE BEST THE BEST THE BEST THE BEST

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!spam the best ; the worst
send hortbot #foobar [HB] THE BEST THE WORST
